newsitem.title: USA: Continental Air to expand internationally.
newsitem.headline: Continental Air to expand internationally.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said it plans to focus on expansion into Asia and South America in 1997.
Continental said it is seeking regulatory approval to serve Sao Paulo and Rio De Janiero from its Newark, N.J., hub.
The airline said it does not plan to expand domestically, but will "optimize" its existing U.S. markets.

Continental said it gains about $15-$20 million in annual revenues from each international city it adds to its route system. The Houston-based airline declined to comment on how much it expects to gain from its 1997 expansion.
The airline said its current relationships with Air France, Alitalia and Aeroflot generate about $70 million total in annual revenues.
